title: Title Collateral Share in Trade-In Chargebacks
content:
Where Kestrel Auto Finance is the lienholder named on the new title, a **Trade-In Agreements** title-delay chargeback carries a title collateral share. It is read from the title order, under **Title & Registration Services**, of the purchase the trade is applied to: the lienholder it names for the new title and its status.

| Title order of the purchase the trade is applied to | Title collateral share |
|---|---|
| Names Kestrel Auto Finance as lienholder; status registered or completed | 0.9 |
| Names Kestrel Auto Finance as lienholder; any other status | 0.95 |
| Names an outside lender or no lienholder, or there is no title order | One (no reduction) |

The share multiplies the title-delay chargeback once; the chargeback is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Reading the status

| Title order status (Kestrel Auto Finance named as lienholder) | Share |
|---|---|
| Registered | 0.9 |
| Completed | 0.9 |
| Awaiting documents, ready to submit, submitted, rejected or cancelled | 0.95 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A chargeback of $5600.00 before this share, on a trade applied to a purchase whose title order names Kestrel Auto Finance and stands submitted: $5600.00 multiplied by 0.95 is $5320.00.
